enumDescriptions: Standard colors that follow macOS appearance.
Standard light colors.
Standard dark colors.
The Claude theme, following macOS appearance.
Claude Light: ivory paper, warm ink and a clay accent.
Claude Dark: warm charcoal with the same clay accent.
The Tide theme, following macOS appearance.
Tide Light: fog-blue paper with a sea-blue accent.
Tide Dark: deep-sea navy with a sea-blue accent.
The Kelp theme, following macOS appearance.
Kelp Light: lichen paper with moss green.
Kelp Dark: pine black with moss green.
The Dusk theme, following macOS appearance.
Dusk Light: lilac paper with violet.
Dusk Dark: aubergine with violet.
The Fog theme, following macOS appearance.
Fog Light: gray paper with an accent of ink and quiet syntax.
Fog Dark: graphite with an accent of ink and quiet syntax.
The Lighthouse theme, following macOS appearance.
Lighthouse Light: white with one amber beam at full contrast.
Lighthouse Dark: pitch black with one amber beam at full contrast.
harbor.appearance.description: Color theme for Harbor and its terminal. The editor uses the matching Harbor theme; other editor themes remain available in Workbench: Color Theme.

enumDescriptions: Staggered reveals and eased panels.
Short fades only.
No animation.
harbor.motion.description: Motion in Harbor and its editor. macOS Reduce Motion always limits Harbor to subtle.

harbor.activityBar.visibleItems.description: Views shown in the row above Explorer. The rest open from the arrow after the last one; drag icons to reorder them. The sidebar cannot be dragged narrower than this row; close it with Command+B.

harbor.interfaceFontSize.description: Font size in points for Harbor controls. Use Window: Zoom Level for the editor interface.

harbor.liquidGlassEnabled.description: Use translucent highlights for Harbor controls. Respects macOS Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency.

harbor.modeSwitchShortcut.patternErrorMessage: Use modifiers and one letter, number or symbol, such as alt+z or ctrl+alt+z. Reserved editor and terminal shortcuts cannot be used.
harbor.modeSwitchShortcut.description: Switch between the editor and terminal mode. Use ctrl, alt (Option), shift or cmd (Command). Other shortcuts are available in Keyboard Shortcuts.
